question: You requested a 30-question exam based strictly on attached lecture materials, but no files or lecture content were provided. Which action should I take next to proceed correctly?
cited_learning_objective: Confirm receipt and availability of lecture materials before item construction

options.text: Request that you upload the lecture slides now
options.rationale: Correct because construction of items grounded in the provided lecture requires the actual slides or notes; receiving the files enables direct adherence to the stated learning objectives and prevents introducing outside material.

options.text: Proceed to create questions using Step One topics
options.rationale: Wrong because generating items from generic Step 1 topics would violate the requirement to ground every question in the provided lecture; this would be correct only if the user explicitly authorized using standard topics instead of their materials.

options.text: Use my internal knowledge to draft questions now
options.rationale: Wrong because relying on internal knowledge would introduce content not guaranteed to match the user's lecture; this would be correct only if the user had asked for questions based on general expertise rather than their specific materials.

options.text: Search the web for relevant lecture materials now
options.rationale: Wrong because web searching external sources would not ensure fidelity to the user's provided lecture and could introduce unapproved content; this would be correct only if the user permitted using external sources in place of their materials.

options.text: Wait for you to attach materials before proceeding
options.rationale: Wrong because passive waiting without explicitly requesting the upload may delay progress; this would be correct only if the user had already indicated they would attach materials imminently and asked the assistant to hold off.
